title: Shared Context, Separate Engines: Streaming Vision--Language Inference on Edge SoCs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35309v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge SoCs pack CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, yet vision--language model (VLM) runtimes keep generation on one engine and leave the others idle. Streaming VLMs expose further parallelism: new frames arrive while earlier queries are still being answered. Engines differ in compute and memory access and contend when they co-run, so no single placement of stages wins across SoCs and workloads. Backend-local KV state keeps other engines from continuing the work. \name coordinates heterogeneous accelerators to execute stateful VLM inference concurrently. It separates a stream's versioned context from each engine's KV state, so any engine can continue the stream by reusing, importing, or reconstructing that state. Stateful Streaming Generation ingests new frames on one engine while another answers, and Concurrent Sequence Generation serves different ready requests in parallel. translated_title: 共享上下文，独立引擎：边缘SoC上的流式视觉-语言推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35309v2 公告类型：新 摘要：边缘SoC集成了CPU、GPU和NPU，然而视觉-语言模型（VLM）的运行时却将生成任务固定在单个引擎上，让其他引擎处于闲置状态。流式VLM进一步暴露了可利用的并行性：在较早的查询尚未回答完毕时，新帧就已经到达。各引擎在计算能力和内存访问方式上存在差异，并且在共同运行时会相互争抢资源，因此不存在一种在所有SoC和工作负载下都最优的统一阶段部署方案。后端局部的KV状态使得其他引擎无法接续未完成的工作。本文提出的系统协调异构加速器以并发执行有状态的VLM推理。它将流的版本化上下文与各引擎的KV状态分离，使得任何引擎都可以通过重用、导入或重建该状态来接续处理同一个流。有状态流式生成在一个引擎上摄取新帧的同时由另一个引擎进行回答，并发序列生成则并行处理不同的就绪请求。状态感知调度将每个请求发送至预计能最快完成它的引擎……
tldr: 提出了一种在边缘SoC上协调CPU、GPU、NPU等异构加速器并发执行有状态流式VLM推理的系统，通过将流的版本化上下文与各引擎的KV状态分离，实现任意引擎可接续处理数据流，从而支持流式生成、并行序列生成和状态感知调度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a system that coordinates heterogeneous accelerators (CPU, GPU, NPU) on edge SoCs to concurrently execute stateful streaming VLM inference, by decoupling a stream's versioned context from per-engine KV state so any engine can continue the stream, enabling stateful streaming generation, concurrent sequence generation, and state-aware dispatch.
